item.title: Re: The Hungry Constellation
item.content:encoded:
Ah… Well, at least it's good to know what went wrong with my idea. Didn't expect it to get bombarded by all this but here we are.

3) It has to be just within the jaws, anything that hits the jaw relative to the observer is destroyed. But if, say, half of a galaxy only hits the jaw, only that part will get destroyed.

4) Yeah, now that I think of it, probably.

Okay, I'm still new to the SCP wiki despite my year since I created an account. Sorry for being a rule-breaker but I was never a guide reader.

Ill try to force myself to read that little link above, in the meantime, Ill see how I can improve on the idea.

item.title: Re: The Hungry Constellation
item.content:encoded:
You've got four problems as is:

1) Formatting. You need to put this into the proper format even if it's just an idea.

2) It's going to need a defined height so that the observing group can get above it. Otherwise, it's going to work great against satellites.

3) Is there a limit to the size of the object, or does it need to just within the jaws? Could it destroy a star?

4) You need to come up with a way to eliminate this one. It's possibly too powerful, even considering the other SCP's.

item.title: The Hungry Constellation
item.content:encoded:
A shape-shifting constellation that can give anomalous properties to whatever it 'eats' based on a two-dimensional perspective from a specific observer

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

The anomaly is a constellation that can take the shape of any Earth-like creature that has a mouth that can be displayed easily in two-dimensions from a perspective, say, a beak. The anomaly is inactive by default, but can be activated for a while if a selected group of people see it, a group which I haven't decided on yet. Once activated, the jaws or beaks or etc. of the constellation closes very slowly, and anything that is 'inside' the jaw relative to the observer from the group of people is destroyed.

In a nutshell, a constellation that gets hungry when a select observer from a group of people sees it.
